items.title: Extract root resolution and activity policy helpers
items.context: Move effective root selection, activity source/write policy, and related runtime helper code out of cli-engine.ts while keeping command behavior unchanged.
items.userSees: Expected transcript includes "command catalog smoke passed" or configured validate PASS while root/activity behavior remains unchanged after extraction.

happy.desc: resolveRoot, resolveMainRootFromWorktreeRoot, resolveRootForCommand, and activity policy helpers move into focused cli modules while cli-engine.ts keeps compatibility exports/imports.

edge.desc: Worktree-to-main-root fallback remains stable for post-command activity logging, including when the original worktree is gone or cwd resolution would otherwise drift.

adversarial.desc: Read-only commands do not start writing activity by default, and global-fallback/source classification remains unchanged unless the explicit activity environment flags request it.

items.title: Extract owner lease and reviewer gate helpers
items.context: Move ownerLeaseHelpBlock, resolveEffectiveOwnershipClass, enforceStoryOwnerLeaseGate, reviewer gate read-only helpers, and related guard code into focused modules without weakening gates.
items.userSees: Expected transcript includes "command ownership contract passed" and "reviewer-readonly command policy smoke passed" after gate helper extraction.

happy.desc: ownerLeaseHelpBlock, resolveEffectiveOwnershipClass, enforceStoryOwnerLeaseGate, and reviewer-readonly helpers move into cli modules while cli-engine.ts keeps compatibility re-exports for existing tests/consumers.

edge.desc: Special effective-ownership cases remain unchanged: B-META finding updates, validate evidence writes, delivery_check_set actor handling, and memory commands keep their documented owner-gate behavior.

adversarial.desc: Foreign-owned story mutating commands still reject without stealing the lease, takeover rules remain explicit, and LATTICE_REVIEWER_READONLY=1 blocks non-readOnly commands before hooks or lease mutation.

items.title: Verify runtime and gate contract preservation
items.context: Run build plus process/runtime fact contract checks and targeted reviewer/owner gate smokes to prove the extraction preserved enforcement semantics.
items.userSees: Build, process-fact contract, ownership contract, and lock/reviewer smokes stay green after the runtime/gate extraction.

happy.desc: TypeScript build and process-fact contract pass after extraction; cli-engine compatibility exports continue compiling all existing consumers.

edge.desc: command-ownership-contract and main-write-lock-coverage continue to pass, proving ownership class/gate and main shared mutation semantics did not drift.

adversarial.desc: The implementation does not move flag parsing, aliases, command catalog, lifecycle special dispatch, INIT_CHECK metadata sync, or recover_evidence dispatch in this story.
